explain.say: Now farmers sow the kharif crops, which means the crops of the rainy season: rice, cotton, maize and soybeans. Rice loves standing water, so the paddy fields fill up. They are harvested around October. Why do you think rice is planted in the rain?

faq.q: When does the monsoon start in India?
faq.a: The monsoon usually reaches Kerala, in the far south, around 1 June, and covers the whole country by about early July. It pulls back from mid-September to October.
asks: When does the rainy season start in India?

faq.q: What are kharif and rabi crops?
faq.a: Kharif crops are sown with the monsoon in June and July and harvested around October, like rice, maize, cotton and soybeans. Rabi crops are sown in winter and harvested in spring, like wheat, barley, mustard and chickpeas.
asks: What crops grow in the monsoon?

faq.q: Why is it so hot before the monsoon?
faq.a: In May the sun is almost overhead in much of India, skies are clear and the dry land heats up fast. This strong heating helps pull moist ocean air in, which brings the monsoon.
asks: Why is May the hottest month in India?

faq.q: What happens if the monsoon fails?
faq.a: A weak or late monsoon can cause drought: crops fail, wells and reservoirs run low, and food prices rise. Farmers without irrigation suffer most.
Yes. Monsoons bring seasonal rain to Bangladesh, Thailand, Vietnam and much of East Asia, to West Africa and the Sahel, to northern Australia and to parts of Mexico and the south-west USA.
asks: Is there a monsoon in Africa?

facts: The monsoon normally reaches Kerala around 1 June.
About 70 to 75% of India's yearly rainfall falls in the June to September monsoon.
Around half of India's farmland depends on rain rather than irrigation.

quiz.say: Which crop is sown at the start of the monsoon?
quiz.show: At the start of the monsoon, farmers sow…
quiz.why: Rice is a kharif crop and needs lots of water, so it is planted in the monsoon.

wrong.1: Wheat is a rabi crop, sown in winter.
wrong.2: Mustard is a rabi crop, sown in winter.

quiz.say: Around when does the monsoon usually reach Kerala?
quiz.show: The monsoon usually reaches Kerala around…
quiz.why: The monsoon normally arrives in Kerala around the first of June.

wrong.1: January is in the dry winter season.
wrong.2: By October the monsoon is pulling back.
